title: Recently Viewed Products
content: Build recently viewed products section. Layout: horizontal scroll carousel. Products: compact cards with image, name, price, quick add button. Behavior: tracks products user has viewed, stores in localStorage. Display: show on homepage, PDP, cart page. Clear option: "Clear History" link. Empty state: hide section if no history. Limit: show last 10-12 products.

variants.simple: Create recently viewed products horizontal scroll section.
variants.detailed: Build recently viewed products section. Layout: horizontal scroll carousel. Products: compact cards with image, name, price, quick add button. Behavior: tracks products user has viewed, stores in localStorage. Display: show on homepage, PDP, cart page. Clear option: "Clear History" link. Empty state: hide section if no history. Limit: show last 10-12 products.
variants.advanced: Build recently viewed products section with persistent tracking. Section container: py-8 with header "Recently Viewed" or "Continue Shopping". Layout: horizontal scroll carousel (flex overflow-x-auto snap-x gap-4 pb-4 hide-scrollbar), or responsive grid for larger displays. Navigation: left/right arrow buttons (hidden on mobile), fade edges indicating more content. Product cards: compact variant (w-48 flex-shrink-0), aspect-square image, product name (line-clamp-2), price, optional "Quick Add" button on hover. Click: entire card links to product page. Tracking behavior: on product page view, add product to history (ID, timestamp, basic info), avoid duplicates (move to front if already in history), limit to last 20-30 products, debounce/throttle tracking to avoid excessive writes. Storage: localStorage with key "recentlyViewed", store product IDs and timestamps, fetch full product data from API or include minimal data in storage, handle storage quota exceeded gracefully. Cross-device sync: if user logged in, optionally sync to account for cross-device access. Display locations: homepage (below hero or fold), product detail pages (related products area), cart page (before checkout), empty cart page, search results when few results. Clear history: "Clear History" text link, confirms action, clears localStorage and hides section. Privacy consideration: note in privacy policy about local storage tracking. Empty state: completely hide section if no viewed history, or show "No recently viewed items" with CTA to shop. Filtering: optionally filter out current product from display on PDP, filter out out-of-stock items, filter out items already in cart. Analytics: track if user purchases from recently viewed section for recommendation optimization. Session vs persistent: toggle between session-only (sessionStorage) or persistent (localStorage) based on privacy settings. Loading: skeleton cards while fetching product details, or instant display if full data cached. Order: most recent first (left to right). Mobile: smaller cards (w-36), touch scroll with snap points. Accessibility: carousel navigable via keyboard, products focusable with clear labels.
